thread:
maria: Quick pass on the launch post draft — focusing headline, benchmark callouts, and CTA routing for webinar registrants. Can someone own the publish checklist?

sam: I can take HubSpot mapping and CTA flows. Do we want separate CTAs for self-serve vs enterprise?

jordan: Yes — two CTAs. Self-serve -> "Start free" flow, Enterprise -> "Talk to sales". Also proposing to call out two benchmark numbers: ~40% latency drop and ~30% cost reduction. Riley, need legal on those phrases.

maria: Good. Sam, map the HS lists and add hidden fields for tagging. I'll write the hero + 3 bullets.

sam: Hidden field example to include in the form payload for tagging:
```json
{ "fieldName": "launch_source", "value": "blog_launch_2026" }
```
Also planning webhook to /webhooks/registrant so we can zap to sales.

sam: Question — should webinar registrants be auto-tagged as both 'launch-webinar-registrant' and 'bench-interested'? That would help routing.

riley: Quick legal note — the numbers need attribution and a short methodology line. Avoid absolute wording like "the fastest" or "always". Recommend: "Internal benchmark: see methodology below."

maria: I'll add an attribution line at the end and remove absolutes. Jordan, can you add the methodology paragraph and a brief note on datasets/hardware?

jordan: Done — uploaded draft to Drive (link in doc) and added a 3-sentence methodology note. Also added an FAQ Q: "How were benchmarks measured?"

sam: HubSpot mapping drafted (form id: 5f3a). Tags: launch-webinar-registrant, bench-interested. Webhook + zap to #sales-inbound ready. I can change mapping if legal requests a softer claim.

maria: Two final asks before we lock: 1) DevRel sanity-check snippets for technical accuracy. 2) Legal sign-off on benchmark copy. Can both be done by EOD tomorrow?

devrel-bot: @maria DevRel queue noted — assigning @lex for snippet review. ETA: tomorrow 11:00am PT. :white_check_mark:

lex: I'll check code snippets and model numbers. If I find any minor wording changes I'll ping.

riley: I can confirm bench wording by EOD tomorrow, will suggest non-absolute phrasing if needed.

maria: Perfect — aiming to publish Thurs 09:00 PT if all clear. I'll update the calendar invite, schedule the CMS publish, and queue the webinar CTA. :rocket:

sam: I'll also schedule the HubSpot auto-email for registrants to go out 24h before webinar.

jordan: Thanks team — once legal + DevRel sign off I’ll finalize the doc and attach assets (PNG benchmarks, short GIF).

maria: Awesome. Locking for now — will post final checklist here after legal/devrel confirm.
